messages:
maria: Heads-up — bringing up marigold-14b on the runtime to validate rotary/KV compatibility. seeing weird token shifts in the smoke outputs.
eli: Thanks, can you paste a short reproducer and which engine build?
sasha: Build is `runtime-2.14.0` + custom kernel fallback. Quantized to 4-bit with our new dynamic scale path.
maria: Minimal repro: run the small-chat scenario with a 3-turn context, compare outputs vs fp16.

```
# repro snippet
python tools/repro_smoke.py --model marigold-14b --quant q4 --engine runtime-2.14.0 --prompt tests/smoke/3turn.json
```

maria: Error pattern: responses are shifted by one token after the second turn, looks like KV alignment/offset issue.
noah: That smells like RoPE rotary scaling mismatch between compiled attention kernel and kv cache indexing. Did you try disabling rotary scale optimization?
maria: Yup — toggled `--disable-rotary-scale` and the token alignment fixed, but latency increased ~8%.
eli: Interesting. Can you paste the small log around the mismatch?
maria: Sure — trimmed log:
```
[2026-03-18 10:12:07] ATTENTION kernel: rotary_scale=1.000000
[2026-03-18 10:12:07] KV_CACHE append idx=512 len=128
[2026-03-18 10:12:07] decode token=42 expected=43
[2026-03-18 10:12:07] decode token=43 actual=44
```
sasha: Looks like the kernel is applying ROTARY with a different base index than the KV store. Could be an off-by-one in the seq_len offset when we stitch cached past keys.
noah: Are you running with continuous-batching enabled? That can change how cached offsets are computed.
maria: Yes batcher on default policy. Re-ran with `BATCHER_MODE=static` and the problem persisted.
sam: I can reproduce locally on my dev node — will instrument the KV index math to dump offsets per layer.
eli: Great — also try the same run on `runtime-2.13.x` (previous kernel) to see if the regression is new.

deploy-bot: smoke-check marigold-14b @staging passed=3 failed=1 (see logs)

sam: Quick note — 2.13 shows no shift. Narrowing to commits between `ae9f..b1c3` where we merged the rotary micro-optimizations.
sasha: If it's the optimization, maybe quantization interacts — the dynamic 4-bit path changes scale computation ordering which exposes the offset bug.
eli: Action items: (1) sam to add per-layer kv_offset dump and rotary phase debug prints, (2) maria to run fp16 vs q4 with `--disable-rotary-scale` to collect perf/quality delta, (3) sam/eli to bisect commits between ae9f..b1c3.
maria: Added perf numbers in the thread: fp16 median latency 82ms, q4+rotary-scale median 75ms, q4+rotary-disabled 81ms. Quality regressed only when rotary-scale + q4 combined.

qa-bot: Created ticket INF-2142: "marigold-14b: rotary-scale + q4 -> KV token shift" assigned to sam/eli.
eli: I'll take the bisect, sam add the debug dumps to the failing CI job so we can iterate faster.
noah: FYI add a cfg flag `kv_index_mode=v1|v2` for temporary rollout so we can A/B and not block the whole model.
sasha: Good plan. Also add an eval set run for conversational drift to ensure we catch subtle shifts in logits.
maria: Thanks all — leaving the staging deploy paused until we have a patch. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
